title: A Practical Deep Learning Model in Differentiating Pneumonia-Type Lung Carcinoma from Pneumonia on CT Images: ResNet Added with Attention Mechanism
summary: The study reports AUC around 0.82 and diagnostic performance on its independent test set and cross-validation. This is a retrospective, single-center evaluation; prospective and external clinical validation are not established.
ai_technology: A lesion-segmenting U-Net and attention-augmented ResNet classify pneumonia-type lung carcinoma versus pneumonia on CT.
